title: C¹ approximation of Lipschitz functions (Simon Ch. 2, Thm 1.5)
statement: Let n ≥ 1 and let f : ℝⁿ → ℝ (ℝⁿ = Rn n = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) be Lipschitz with constant K ∈ ℝ≥0. Then for every ε ∈ (0, ∞] there is a C¹ function g : ℝⁿ → ℝ (ContDiff ℝ 1 g) such that the Lebesgue measure (volume) of {x : f(x) ≠ g(x)} is less than ε. (Simon Ch. 2, Theorem 1.5; used for the cited fact (H4) of the parent proof.)
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (f : Rn n → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K f → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ g : Rn n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ volume {x | f x ≠ g x} < ε
